hero.headline: I help campuses and brands grow, with *data* behind every decision.
hero.lead: I’m a 2nd-year BCA student in Bengaluru who runs events, builds communities and queries data in SQL and Python. I’m looking for a marketing, growth or community internship where I can keep learning by shipping real work.

about.statement: A 2nd-year BCA student who connects technology, analytics and community to help brands reach their audience and leave a mark.
about.paragraph: I’m Hitesh, a second-year BCA student at Nagarjuna College of Engineering and Technology (NCET) in Bengaluru (Current CGPA: 7.50 · Class of 2028). I got into marketing through events and communities, then realised the best decisions come from data. So I study both: I write SQL and Python for my degree, and I apply them while running student communities, workshops, and hackathon operations.
